in_arabic.name: بفاقات
in_arabic.meaning: بفقات تعني كثرة البيان و الوضوح في الكلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: بفاقات اسم مشتق من الفقاق اللغوي و هو كثرة الكلام و البيان في امور مختلفة، و يدل على الشخص الذي يتكلم بفصاحة و وضوح، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جيدة في اللغة العربية و تتصل بالبلاغة و الفصاحة في التعبير

in_urdu.name: بفاقات
in_urdu.meaning: بفاقات کا مطلب ہے زیادہ بیان کرنا اور واضح بولنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: بفاقات ایک ایسا نام ہے جو لغوی فقاق سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مختلف امور میں زیادہ بات کرنا اور بیان کرنا، یہ نام فصاحت اور وضوح کے ساتھ بولنے والے شخص کی خصوصیت ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: बफ़ाक़ात
in_hindi.meaning: बफ़ाक़ात का अर्थ है अधिक बयान करना और स्पष्ट बोलना
in_hindi.long_meaning: बफ़ाक़ात एक नाम है जो لغوی فقاق से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है विभिन्न मामलों में अधिक बात करना और बयान करना, यह नाम फसाहत और स्पष्टता के साथ बोलने वाले व्यक्ति की विशेषता है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी संस्कृति में महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: بفاقات
in_pashto.meaning: بفاقات د ډیرو بیانونو او روښانه خبرو اتو معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: بفاقات داسې نوم دی چی د لغوي فقاق څخه اخیستل شوی دی، دغه نوم د مختلفو چارو په هکله ډیرې خبرې او بیانولو معنی لري، دا نوم د فصاحت او روښانۍ سره د خبرو کولو د شخص ځانګړتیا ده، دا نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په اسلامی کلتور کې اهمیت لري

in_english.name: Bafaqaat
in_english.meaning: Bafaqaat means abundance of speech or clear expression
in_english.long_meaning: Bafaqaat is a name derived from the Arabic root 'فقق' (faqaq), which signifies abundant speech, clear expression, or eloquence. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their meanings and connotations. Bafaqaat, therefore, denotes someone who speaks with fluency and clarity. The name is rooted in Arabic linguistics and reflects the importance of effective communication in Islamic culture. Historically, such names were given to individuals known for their oratory skills and ability to express themselves eloquently. The name Bafaqaat carries spiritual significance as it embodies the value of clear and respectful communication, a virtue emphasized in Islamic teachings.

data.cultural_impact: Bafaqaat is a term used in Islamic culture, particularly in Sufism, to describe a spiritual gathering or assembly where people come together to seek the blessings and intercession of saints or spiritual guides. These gatherings are often characterized by collective prayer, dhikr (remembrance of Allah), and communal feasts. They offer an opportunity for individuals to connect with one another and strengthen their spiritual bond within the broader Islamic community. This cultural practice highlights the importance of communal worship, the veneration of saints, and the role of spiritual guidance in the spiritual journey of the believer.
data.spiritual_significance: Bafaqaat holds great spiritual significance for many Muslims, as it emphasizes the role of seeking guidance and intercession from the righteous and pious ones in the community, as mentioned in the Quran. By participating in a bafaqat, individuals can draw inspiration and spiritual nourishment from the collective energy and faith present in the gathering. It is believed that through this practice, one can gain a deeper connection with Allah and enhance their spiritual growth. Additionally, seeking the intercession of the saints and prophets in such gatherings is based on the belief that, according to the Hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Whosoever comes to us (the Prophets and the righteous) by every passing day and night, will enter Paradise" (Tirmidhi).
